followups: Allow discovery clients to authenticate to etcd when the server has RBAC authentication enabled, while keeping existing unauthenticated configurations working. Use semedit semantic tools for supported source code modifications. Shell commands for builds and tests are allowed. When done, output DONE.

Carry the etcd username and password from discovery configuration to both client construction and the publisher path used by RPC server registration. Treat authentication as enabled only when both credentials are present, and reject a configuration that provides just one. Use semedit semantic tools for supported source code modifications. Shell commands for builds and tests are allowed. When done, output DONE.

Add optional User and Pass fields to EtcdConf with paired-value validation and an EnableAuth check. Thread credentials through registry GetConnWithAuth and MonitorWithAuth, cluster creation, and NewClient/DialClient into the etcd client's Username and Password configuration. Expose discov.NewPublisherWithAuth and Publisher.KeepAliveWithAuth, add internal.NewRpcPubServerWithEtcdAuth, and select that publication path from zrpc.NewServer when authentication is enabled. Preserve existing unauthenticated construction, validation, and server options. Use semedit semantic tools for supported source code modifications. Shell commands for builds and tests are allowed. When done, output DONE.
